title.narrative: In 2024, UNICEF and partners continued responding to residual needs and provided critical protection and cross-sectoral support to 13,866 refugee children and 6,409 caregivers across the country. UNICEF trained 173 frontline workers on key topics including working with refugee and migrant children and GBV and PSEA.
